title: Google AI plans with cloud storage – Google One

facts.fact: Google AI Plus includes 400 GB of cloud storage across Gmail, Drive and Photos, according to Google's plan page.
facts.quote: 400 GB storage Unlock essential tools to boost productivity with double the access to Gemini

facts.fact: Google AI Pro includes 5 TB of storage, according to Google's plan page.
facts.quote: 5 TB storage Create faster and get more done with four times more access to Gemini

facts.fact: Google AI Ultra starts at 20 TB of storage, according to Google's plan page.
facts.quote: Starting at 20 TB of storage Accelerate your workflows with five times higher usage limits in Gemini than with the AI Pro plan

facts.fact: Google says Google AI Ultra offers five times higher usage limits in Gemini than the AI Pro plan.
facts.quote: Accelerate your workflows with five times higher usage limits in Gemini than with the AI Pro plan

facts.fact: Google says Google AI Plus gives double the access to Gemini.
facts.quote: Unlock essential tools to boost productivity with double the access to Gemini

facts.fact: Google says Google AI Pro gives four times more access to Gemini.
facts.quote: Create faster and get more done with four times more access to Gemini

facts.fact: Google AI Plus and Google AI Pro both include family sharing with up to five others.
facts.quote: Family sharing with up to five others.

facts.fact: Google AI Pro includes US$10 in monthly Google Cloud credits from the Google Developer Programme.
facts.quote: US$10 in monthly Google Cloud credits from Google Developer Programme.

facts.fact: Google AI Pro includes 200 compute units per month in Google Colab.
facts.quote: Get expanded access to powerful accelerators and longer runtimes in Google Colab with 200 compute units per month.

facts.fact: Google states that the Google Home Premium Standard plan is included at no cost with Google AI Pro, with a stated value of US$10 per month and 30 days of event history.
facts.quote: Get the Google Home Premium Standard plan at no cost (US$10/month value), with 30 days of event history and Gemini features.

facts.fact: Google offers students Google AI Plus at no charge for one year, according to the plan page.
facts.quote: Students get Google AI Plus at no charge of charge for one year

facts.fact: The Google AI plans page lists Gemini 4 Argon as included in the Google AI Plus and Google AI Pro plans.
